title: Sentinel Shield approved scanner-image contract
description: Canonical registry (config/scanner-images.json) of the container images the shipped workflow templates may execute, each recorded with the tag it was resolved from and the immutable digest that tag pointed at. scripts/validate-scanner-images.sh enforces it against the templates; scripts/audits/tool-provenance-audit.sh enforces it against what a run actually executed. It exists because a moving tag (`owasp/dependency-check:latest`) shipped as a production default, so the scanner implementation could change with no repository change and no review.

resolved_at.description: Date the recorded digests were last re-resolved from the registry.

mutable_tags.description: Tags that are, by definition, not immutable. No shipped template may execute one.

images.description: Keyed by the SENTINEL_SHIELD_*_IMAGE environment variable that selects the image.

resolved_from.description: The tag whose manifest resolved to `digest` at `resolved_at`.

digest.description: Full immutable digest. Abbreviated digests are rejected: they are not a pin.

default_pin.description: digest: the shipped default MUST be repository@digest. tag: the shipped default may be the readable immutable version tag, and the digest here is the documented production override.

default_reference.description: The exact value a shipped template must set for this variable.

engine_version.description: Scanner version behind `digest`, recorded from a validated run. When non-null, a produced report whose reported engine version differs is drift and fails visibly. Null means it has not been recorded from a real run yet — it is never guessed.

templates.description: Shipped workflow templates/examples whose *_IMAGE defaults are checked against this contract.
